name: roblox-kit
description: Build a map from a data spec in Roblox Studio, check it for overlapping, floating and unreachable geometry, screenshot each zone and run solo or multiplayer playtests, next to Roblox's built-in Studio MCP tools.

roblox_open_cloud_api_key.title: Roblox Open Cloud API key
roblox_open_cloud_api_key.description: Open Cloud API key with Assets read and write permission, used to upload reviewed hero-prop models. Leave empty to keep set pieces in place of hero props, or to use the key file .roblox-kit/open-cloud-key in the plugin folder.

roblox_creator_user_id.title: Roblox creator user id
roblox_creator_user_id.description: Numeric Roblox user id that owns the uploaded hero-prop models, for a user-owned key. Set this or the group id, not both.

roblox_creator_group_id.title: Roblox creator group id
roblox_creator_group_id.description: Numeric Roblox group id that owns the uploaded hero-prop models, for a group-owned key. Set this or the user id, not both.
